children: Cantor Equity Partners VII appointed Alan Riffkin to its Board as a Class I director and named him to the audit and compensation committees, effective October 14, 2026.
Class I Director; Member, Audit Committee; Member, Compensation Committee

Managing Member of AFR Capital Advisory (since Dec 2020); Exec Chairman & Treasurer of AirWave Lease Insights (since Mar 2024); director of Cantor Equity Partners IV (since Feb 2026); prior roles at Lazard, Goldman Sachs, Citicorp; BS Cornell; MBA Wharton.
Appointed to Audit Committee and Compensation Committee
